notes: Override of Any.toString() (name cannot be changed - overrides a library method). Body unconditionally increments the companion counter anInt1180 then throws IllegalStateException() - i.e. this class deliberately refuses to be stringified. This is the same pattern as other 'poison-pill toString' stub classes elsewhere in the codebase (e.g. UnusedToStringStub). Despite the class's name, this class's instances (aMovementDirection_1179/1181/.../1187, values 1/2/4, i.e. small power-of-two int tags) are used pervasively as a generic typed field on unrelated GPU resource classes (e.g. `var aMovementDirection_3895: MovementDirection` on D3DBaseTexture, and similarly on several Gl*/D3D* texture and index-buffer classes across jvmMain) rather than for movement/direction. That strongly suggests these instances are really acting as a resource-usage/pool tag (akin to D3DUSAGE/GL buffer-usage style STATIC=1/DYNAMIC=2/STREAM=4 flags) that happens to share this class, and the deliberate toString() failure is consistent with 'this is an identity-only flag object, never meant to be printed/concatenated' rather than anything related to actual movement direction. Flagging this class-name/usage mismatch for awareness; only the method (toString) is in scope for this file's CSV, and its name is fixed by the Any contract.
